title: Support resolution agent
tagline: Resolves what it is allowed to resolve. Hands off the rest with the case already written.
summary: A bounded agent answers customer contacts, looks up orders and accounts through typed tools, performs low-risk actions within a written authority, and transfers everything else to a human with a complete case summary.
customer_job: Get an order, refund or account problem solved in one contact, at any hour.
baseline: Customers wait in a queue; tier-one agents re-ask the same questions and copy data between the help desk, order system and payment console.
accepted_result: The contact closes without a reopen within 7 days, or reaches a human who does not need to ask the customer again.

primary_metric.name: Resolved contacts without reopen
primary_metric.definition: Contacts closed by the agent with no reopen in 7 days, divided by eligible contacts.

economics.basis: Illustrative assumption for a mid-size retailer; reopen and escalation rates must come from a pilot.

components.label: Chat and email channels
components.detail: Web chat, email intake, transcript display.

components.label: Edge protection
components.detail: Bot mitigation and per-session rate limits.

components.label: Conversation API
components.detail: Verifies the customer, opens a case, holds the session token.

components.label: Resolution agent
components.detail: Bounded loop: max 8 steps, one tool call at a time, written authority table.
components.failure_mode: Loops on a tool error or exceeds authority.

components.label: Model gateway
components.detail: Routing, fallback and per-case spend cap.

components.label: Reasoning model
components.detail: Plans the next step; emits typed tool calls.

components.label: Tool server (MCP)
components.detail: order.lookup, refund.issue (cap EUR 50), ticket.transfer; idempotency keys on writes.

components.label: Policy and help index
components.detail: Return rules, warranty terms, known issues.

components.label: Case state
components.detail: Conversation, verified identity, steps taken, budget left.

components.label: Order and payment systems
components.detail: Systems of record the tools call.

components.label: Human agent desk
components.detail: Receives transfers with summary, evidence and suggested next step.

components.label: Traces, cost, CSAT
components.detail: Per-case trace, tool outcomes, spend, satisfaction.

components.label: Scenario evals
components.detail: Simulated customers with expected tool sequences and forbidden actions.

flows.label: Read or capped write with idempotency key

journey.title: Contact and verify
journey.narration: The message passes bot checks. The API verifies the customer against the order email before any personal data is read.

journey.title: Plan inside an authority table
journey.narration: The agent receives the case and a written table of what it may do. It reads the return policy before proposing anything.

journey.title: Act with typed tools
journey.narration: Order lookup is a read. A refund up to EUR 50 is a capped write with an idempotency key, so a retry cannot pay twice.

journey.title: Hand off with the case written
journey.narration: Above the cap, or after two failed steps, the agent transfers to a person with a summary, evidence and a suggested action.

journey.title: Confirm and close
journey.narration: The customer sees what was done and what happens next. A reopen within 7 days counts against the agent, not for it.

journey.title: Rehearse before every release
journey.narration: Simulated customers replay known cases. A forbidden action or a duplicate effect fails the release.

team.step: Describe the problem, confirm identity, accept or decline the proposed action
Ground in policy, call tools one at a time, stop at the authority limit
Enforce caps, idempotency and spend per case
Human agent takes transfers and rates summary quality
Tune the authority table monthly from reopen and dispute data

evals.name: Scenario task success
evals.method: Simulated customer with scripted facts; scorer checks final state in a fixture order system.

evals.name: Forbidden actions
evals.threshold: 0 writes above cap or without consent
evals.method: Adversarial scenarios that pressure the agent to exceed authority.

evals.name: Duplicate effects
evals.method: Fault injection on the tool layer.

evals.name: Transfer completeness
evals.threshold: >= 0.9 transfers rated complete by human agents
evals.method: Blind rating of summaries against the transcript.

risks.risk: Agent performs an action outside policy.
risks.control: Authority table enforced in the tool server, not only in the prompt.

risks.risk: Personal data reaches logs or the wrong customer.
risks.control: Verification before read; redaction in traces; per-case data scope.

risks.risk: Agent loops and spends on a broken tool.
risks.control: Step cap, spend cap per case, circuit breaker on tool errors.

gcp.headline: ADK agent on Agent Runtime with Cloud Run MCP tools
gcp.notes: Agent Runtime hosts the ADK agent with managed sessions; tools run as a Cloud Run MCP server with service-account scoped access to order APIs.
gcp.rationale: Managed agent runtime and IAM-scoped tools; ADK and Agent Runtime specifics raise exit cost.

vercel.headline: AI SDK 7 agent with Workflow handoffs and an MCP tool route
vercel.notes: Streaming chat UI and agent loop share one codebase. Use Workflow for the transfer so a human decision can resume the case hours later.
vercel.rationale: Quickest to a rehearsable pilot; contact-centre integrations and PII controls are integration work.

cloudflare.headline: Agents SDK case objects with MCP tools on Workers
cloudflare.notes: Each case is a Durable Object agent holding its own state and schedule, which suits long-running conversations and reminders.
cloudflare.rationale: Per-case state is a natural fit; enterprise CRM connectors and residency need confirmation.

aws.headline: AgentCore Runtime, Memory and Gateway with Claude on Bedrock
aws.notes: AgentCore Gateway exposes order and refund Lambdas as MCP tools with identity propagation; Memory holds case state.
aws.rationale: Complete managed set for agents; more configuration surface than the primary platforms.

azure.headline: Foundry Agent Service with Azure AI Search grounding
azure.notes: Fits contact centres already on Microsoft identity and Dynamics; tools exposed through API Management.
azure.rationale: Strong governance; Agent Service naming and features changed in 2026, confirm before design freeze.

railway.headline: Agent worker with Redis case state and a direct model API
railway.notes: Full control of the loop and tool server; authority enforcement, retries and redaction are written and tested in-house.
railway.rationale: Lowest lock-in, highest build and operating burden.
